roadmapPosition: Alpha 7.5 art direction and room cleanup

valueRules.midground: 14–42% value; no edge frequency behind combat
valueRules.platformTop: 58–78% value with a continuous top edge
valueRules.foreground: 8–30% value; never masks collision or telegraphs

densityRules.high: 4–6 prop clusters; challenge/boss only with protected combat lanes
densityRules.rejected: more than 6 clusters, repeated micro-detail behind actors, or decoration crossing platform/hazard silhouettes

mobileRules: protect the middle 64% of the screen from high-frequency decoration
keep essential telegraphs at least 24 px from safe-area edges at 1280×720 reference
remove one background and one foreground cluster from the desktop standard variant
never communicate a hazard through color alone

biomes.name: The Neon Maw
biomes.concept: A ravenous infernal nightclub whose architecture feels like a smiling mouth.
biomes.lighting: Low frontal club wash; magenta rim from screen-right; cyan reserved for navigation and interactables.
biomes.saturation: Characters and attacks first; signs second; walls and crowd silhouettes muted.
biomes.enemySilhouette: Compact street-demon shapes; horns and weapons must clear the torso.
biomes.bossSilhouette: Demon Lords occupy a tall hourglass or monstrous appetite silhouette with unmistakable infernal anatomy.
biomes.accentRule: Magenta names appetite and hostile spectacle; cyan names routes and safe interaction.
forbidden: purple hazards that merge with Milo’s bolt

biomes.name: The Drowned Court
biomes.concept: A submerged fan-palace where worship, currents and song become pressure.
biomes.lighting: Cool caustic top light; silhouettes darken downward; coral rim only on performers.
biomes.saturation: Cyan currents and coral attacks lead; palace stone and water haze stay desaturated.
biomes.enemySilhouette: Aquatic profiles need open fins, shells or vocal apparatus; never hide feet/hover anchors in foam.
biomes.bossSilhouette: Nerissa must read as a horned/fin-crested Demon Lord, not an ordinary singer; pillars remain separate targets.
biomes.accentRule: Cyan is movement/current; coral-pink is adoration magic and enemy danger.
forbidden: cyan enemy shots without a danger core
dry palace props placed without water logic

biomes.name: The Thornwild
biomes.concept: A predatory forest built from hunting lanes, traps and living roots.
biomes.lighting: Broken canopy light from upper-left; warm threat glow from snares and eyes.
biomes.saturation: Foliage remains olive; acid-green growth and red-orange danger carry gameplay meaning.
biomes.enemySilhouette: Predators lean forward with clear claws, jaws or ranged limbs; foliage never shares their outline.
biomes.bossSilhouette: Roxyne requires horned demonic regalia plus a wide hunter silhouette and separated weapon arcs.
biomes.accentRule: Acid green is living/armed growth; red-orange is immediate damage and hunting marks.
forbidden: green enemy attacks without a hot danger center

biomes.name: The Thunder Jackpot
biomes.concept: A demonic casino-storm where every rule change is loudly disclosed and electrically timed.
biomes.lighting: Hard gold marquee pools from above; cyan lightning backlight; violet walls stay low value.
biomes.saturation: Gold is reward/chance; cyan is timed electricity; magenta-purple remains structural only.
biomes.enemySilhouette: Dealers and chance-creatures use angular sleeves, card fans or dice masses with uncluttered hands.
biomes.bossSilhouette: Calyptra needs crown/horns and a broad casino-empress silhouette; chance devices remain distinct appendages.
biomes.accentRule: Gold always signals value/opportunity; cyan signals active electricity or countdown.
forbidden: gold enemy projectiles without red danger edging
biomes.density: standard; high only in jackpot reveal states

biomes.name: The Frozen Basilica
biomes.concept: A cold cathedral of memory where momentum, delay and fracture are readable before they punish.
biomes.lighting: Cold clerestory shafts from upper-center; delayed attacks gain a warm warning core.
biomes.saturation: Ice remains pale blue-gray; cyan edges navigation; warm danger accents are rare and decisive.
biomes.enemySilhouette: Use heavy crystal masses or thin devotional profiles; feet and slide direction remain visible.
biomes.bossSilhouette: Isolde reads as a demonic frozen warden through crown/horns, asymmetrical crystal armor and a dominant ward shape.
biomes.accentRule: Pale cyan describes safe ice geometry; warm coral cores mark armed delayed threats.
forbidden: mirror-polished floors that hide platform edges
biomes.density: low-to-standard; negative space is part of the cold

biomes.name: The Forever Motel
biomes.concept: A looping dream motel that feels familiar at first glance and wrong on the second.
biomes.lighting: Sickly ceiling pools with long horizontal shadows; impossible doors use a restrained violet rim.
biomes.saturation: Faded mauve and nicotine beige dominate; active dream loops receive the only bright accent.
architecture: identical rooms with one wrong detail
biomes.enemySilhouette: Dream guests use recognizable human hotel silhouettes corrupted by one large impossible feature.
biomes.bossSilhouette: Somnia requires queenly demon horns and trailing sleep geometry that breaks the motel’s rigid rectangles.
biomes.accentRule: Cream marks ordinary familiarity; violet-pink marks dream interference and false space.
biomes.density: low; repetition supplies identity without extra objects

biomes.name: The City of a Thousand Faces
biomes.concept: A vertical mirror metropolis where reflections redirect danger and identity fractures into readable copies.
biomes.lighting: Cool edge light from mirror planes; reflected attacks retain a hot enemy-danger core.
biomes.saturation: Architecture stays blue-gray; cyan identifies physical mirrors; lavender identifies identity distortion.
biomes.enemySilhouette: Copies must differ through one readable borrowed attack shape; masks cannot obscure body direction.
biomes.bossSilhouette: Vespera is a horned Demon Lord framed by a multi-face mantle; false bodies have lower contrast than the true body.
biomes.accentRule: Cyan is physical reflection geometry; lavender is copied identity; red core remains hostile ownership.
forbidden: reflections identical in contrast to actors
biomes.density: standard; mirror count capped per sightline

biomes.name: Lilith’s Throne
biomes.concept: A disciplined infernal capital and royal gauntlet built around blood authority, not generic erotic clutter.
biomes.lighting: Crimson throne light from deep background; pale rim isolates Milo and enemies from black architecture.
biomes.saturation: Blood-red belongs to royal power and curses; violet marks court magic; neutral black carries most mass.
biomes.enemySilhouette: Court demons use ranked crown/wing shapes; each role owns a distinct weapon arc and stance.
biomes.bossSilhouette: Lilith must dominate the frame as an unmistakable demon queen through horns, wings, tail/regalia and throne-scale staging.
biomes.accentRule: Bright blood-red is active royal threat; muted wine is architecture; pale violet is secondary court magic.
forbidden: Lilith reading as only a glamorous human woman
biomes.density: standard-to-high in ceremonies; combat lanes remain sparse

biomes.name: The Self Below
biomes.concept: A stripped mirror realm where past bosses and Milo’s avoided selves appear against deliberate emptiness.
biomes.lighting: Single neutral key on the active duel; memory fragments fade into low-contrast void.
biomes.saturation: Near-monochrome world; inherited boss colors appear briefly; Milo purple remains the stable through-line.
biomes.enemySilhouette: Returning enemies use simplified memory silhouettes; only the active threat reaches full contrast.
biomes.bossSilhouette: The Hollow mirrors Milo’s scale first, then grows through avoided-self fragments without becoming an unreadable mass.
biomes.accentRule: Gray establishes truth/emptiness; purple identifies Milo/Arcane continuity; restored boon colors appear one at a time.
forbidden: Hollow effects that obscure Milo’s matching silhouette
biomes.density: low by default; spectacle is event-driven

sequenceRules.campaignLength: Level 1 is the baseline; Level 2 adds 2–3 rooms; each later level adds 1–3 rooms over the previous level.
sequenceRules.miniBossWindow: one campaign mini-boss at 45–55% of required rooms
sequenceRules.emptyRoomDefinition: no enemies, hazard challenge, reward decision, wager, narrative beat or traversal test
sequenceRules.branchCooldown: at least two resolved rooms between branching decisions
sequenceRules.wagerCooldown: at least three resolved rooms between wager offers unless a biome-authored event overrides it

budgets.enemyBudget: weighted by role and simultaneous threat, not raw count
budgets.hazardBudget: 0 recovery; 0–2 standard; 1–3 challenge with compatibility exclusions
budgets.performanceWeight: low/medium/high plus estimated active projectiles, particles, animated props and offscreen actors

automatedChecks: entry and every required exit share a traversable graph
spawn and reward bounds do not overlap solids, hazards or another atlas cell
minimum landing width and head clearance meet Milo controller constants
grounded enemies resolve feet to a valid surface and hoverers declare altitude bands
enemy plus hazard budget remains within the room tier
no contradictory modifier/hazard pair is registered
foreground masks no platform edge, pickup, telegraph or required route
sequence obeys progression, midpoint mini-boss, final boss and no-consecutive-empty rules
mobile variant respects safe-area, touch occlusion and performance weight
seeded generation reproduces the same validated room graph
humanChecks: entry intent and first safe landing are understandable within three seconds
at least one movement-expression route is visible without requiring damage
ordinary rooms include recovery space after burst pressure
Milo, enemies, both projectile owners, hazards, platforms and rewards remain separable in motion
props appear intentionally clustered and physically supported
background perspective, lighting and material treatment agree
challenge-room intimidation comes from composition and telegraphs, not clutter
wavedash routes exist without making ordinary walking/jumping invalid
high-stack effects remain legible against the room at gameplay scale
room still reads on a physical-phone-size landscape preview
rejectReasons: entry spawn under immediate unavoidable damage
enemy or prop floating without authored support
more than six unrelated prop clusters
hazard ownership depends on color alone
platforms appear to belong to the background
room combines mechanics whose telegraphs occupy the same space/time
